author: agent
content:
Creating serverless backend infrastructure with authentication, database, and API layers.

This deployment includes:
- 3 Lambda functions (auth, movies, user management)
- DynamoDB tables for data persistence
- Cognito for user authentication
- API Gateway for routing requests

author: user
content: Can we use a more restrictive IAM policy? I don't want full DynamoDB access.

author: agent
content: Good catch! I've updated the policy to only allow access to tables prefixed with `netflix-clone-`. The change is reflected in the IAM activity above.
